title: axaxo sinni lakmisa num
intro: nabiyyih aydaadih addat, dago mari tannah tan giffole kasaara kee xagar dig axaxime sinni imaan luk coolaysiteenih yanin. ta muucih aydaadi wakti sinni qasiiri sabrii kee qibaadah wale kibal luk. Ta rooci miyyaay?
clues: Anu farmo tatrusuh Yalli dooreh suge, takkay immay yok kaxxa aqayyaare yok temeetem cinna hinna, takkay immay cankâ qawwalaylak temeete.
Yi gaddaay, yi saqa kee yi xaylo yok beenih, tiyaak widiril.
Yi dagar daleelit buuleh sugeeh, yi barra qokolak iroh dubuk raqeh suge.
Anu yi Rabbih weeqeh, inni gandi oggolak kay racmatta faxak.
Anu inni ibat baaxo aatuh amriseh sugeeh, tasqussubeh tan raceenaani caxittah.
Yalli qaafiyat yoh gacseeh, qusba buxah mara yoh yeceeh, duma luk sugeemik mango gadda yoh yecee.
arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
